subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should this grouped export CLI and serialized package contract land before the Claws RFC and prerequisite stack are accepted?
rationale: There is no current-main or shipped Claws export contract, so merging chooses a new core product and compatibility boundary; the environment gate limits discovery but does not remove future migration obligations.

options.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the PR open until the RFC and prerequisite branches settle, then land a self-contained export matching the accepted contract.

options.title: Accept the gated prototype
options.body: Merge the experimental contract now and explicitly own later schema migration or rewrite work as the RFC evolves.

recommendation.title: Wait for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the RFC and prerequisite branches settle, then land a self-contained export matching the accepted contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The protected maintainer signal and adjacent current-main ownership make Peter Steinberger the best available routing candidate for the product-contract decision.
